title: mattstack bindings manifest (pack/skills.jsonc fragment or generated packs/<pack>/skills.jsonc)
description: Consumer-repo manifest: enabled stack skills, the pipeline stage roster, and slot bindings for parameterized skills. JSONC: JSON plus full-line // comments; no trailing commas.

version.description: Manifest format version. This schema describes version 1.

extends.description: Fragment only: the org base pack whose fragment layers under this one, as a bare folder name under the org's mattstack/org/packs/ (for example acme-base). One level; a base pack cannot extend. Never present in a generated file.

base.description: Fragment only: true marks the org base pack, the one team packs name with extends. A base pack never claims a repo, gets no bindings file of its own, and is never installed. Never present in a generated file.

enabled.description: Stack skills this repo uses. Declarative record in phase 1; not read by resolve-args.sh.

pipelines.description: Stage roster for compile (pipeline name -> stage skills). A pipeline a work verb runs starts with stage-provision, ends with stage-watch-ci, and includes stage-implement and stage-ship; any other pipeline takes any order the chain check accepts. A pipeline is a plain list of stages, or an object with its stages and its own bindings, which override the top-level bindings per slot for that pipeline only.

additionalProperties.description: Slot name -> inner skill name, for one wrapper skill.

bindings.description: Wrapper skill name -> slot bindings. The only section resolve-args.sh reads.

additionalProperties.description: Slot name -> inner skill name, or "" to unbind a slot the top-level bindings fill, for this pipeline only.

pipelineBindings.description: Stage skill name -> slot overrides for one pipeline; each slot replaces the top-level binding for that pipeline.
